versions.changelog: Add contact line for custom implementations (pods@agentmail.to)

**Clarified invocation boundaries and updated logging usage.**

- Now explicitly requires human/agent invocation for hard-to-undo actions — will NOT trigger for ambiguous or routine tasks.
- Skill description revised for clarity on scope, manual invocation, and explicit pass/fail requirements per checklist item.
- Permissions section added: clarifies that no configuration files or system state are read.
- Logging example and code updated to require explicit per-item pass/fail in the checklist.
- "What this skill does NOT do" and anti-patterns clarified for stronger safety boundaries.
- Removed unused file (skill-card.md).

Initial release! Introduces a configurable deployment gate to prevent risky or unapproved deploys.

- Enforces structured, role-based checklists before any hard-to-undo action.
- Blocks deployment until all required sign-offs are complete.
- Provides detailed log output for each gate decision (pass or block).
- Supports multi-role and minimal setups; flexible for solo devs or larger teams.
- Includes Python logging helper and ready-to-use checklist templates.
